node.title: Validez histórica y validez al uso
node.summary: A rule can be valid for interpreting a past event and inadequate for a current decision.

relations: A later rule may support historical reinterpretation while being expired or unauthorized for a new action; event time and current-use validity must be checked separately.
Aplicación propuesta desde un contrato de rama de octubre de 2026; no atribuye ese contrato al sistema de 2018.
The dual-time contract makes a later implementation obligation explicit: historical reinterpretation and current permission to rely on a certificate must be evaluated separately.
El contrato permanece en PR60 y requiere infraestructura independiente de firmas, reloj, derechos y estado de revocación.
